rounds.text: Flexituff Ventures International Ltd is demonstrating tangible operational cash generation and positive fundamental momentum that the market has completely overlooked at a micro market capitalisation of ₹ 15.1 Cr [E2, E27, E28]. Operating cash flow and free cash flow both reached ₹ 5 Cr in March 2026, proving the underlying business converts activity into real liquidity despite headline volatility [E27, E28]. Furthermore, the company exhibits a stellar return on equity of 110.98%, significantly outperforming the sector benchmark of 7.19% [E8]. Recent operational metrics show encouraging green shoots, including a net profit increase of 11% year-on-year, quarterly profit growth, and accelerating earnings growth [E54, E55, E56]. This internal turnaround is further bolstered by a strong relative-strength rating of 73 against the Nifty 500 and a favorable sector tailwind in textiles scoring +0.60 [E39, E63]. Conceded: compounded sales growth has suffered badly over trailing periods, including a 97% decline in the trailing twelve months [E15], and borrowings stand at an elevated ₹ 268 Cr alongside high pledged promoter shares [E30, E51].
